Confidence is medium, not high, because three specified devices (4-pole Type B RCBO, TP&N IP44 metalclad 12-way board, 4-pole lockable main switches) are priced from older/different QV rows with a stated uplift at the high end, the export-limit relay is an Australian price needing NZ confirmation, and the electrician hours are estimated. The main cost driver (labour) rests on a cited QV row, so the band is established.
